firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.unavailableHint: Neither ufw nor firewalld is installed on this server. Install one and reload the page.
firewall.portHelp: Single port (80) or range (8000:8100). Leave empty for any port.
firewall.sourceHelp: IP address or CIDR range. Leave empty for any source.
firewall.enableWarning: The panel opens the SSH port and its own port before enabling, so you keep your connection.
firewall.protectedHint: This port cannot be blocked for every source — you would lose access to the server. Blocking individual IPs is still allowed.

firewallErr.unavailable: The server has no usable firewall tool.
firewallErr.critical_port: Port {port} ({name}) cannot be blocked — you would lose access to the server.

appErr.catalog_not_found: Application {app} is not in the catalog.
appErr.name_exists: The name {name} is already used by another application.

appErr.port_in_use: Port {port} is already taken by another process.
appErr.compose_unavailable: Docker Compose is not available on this server.
appErr.install_failed: The install failed. Check the application logs for details.

website.title: Websites
website.deleteConfirm: Delete website {name}? The config file is removed, the source files are kept.
website.name: Name
website.nameHelp: Used as the config file name; letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.
website.domainsHelp: One domain per line, or separated by commas.
website.rootHelp: Directory holding the site files; created if missing.
website.proxyTargetHelp: Service receiving the requests, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3000
website.certificateHelp: Pick a certificate from the SSL certificates tab.
website.forceHttpsHelp: Redirect every HTTP request to HTTPS.
website.extraConfigHelp: Inserted verbatim into the server block. Invalid syntax makes saving fail.
website.serverUnavailable: {server} was not found on this server. Install it before creating websites.
website.stagingHelp: Use the Let's Encrypt staging server: browsers will not trust the certificate, but it does not consume issuance limits.

website.acmeHint: The domains must already point at this server and port 80 must be open, because Let's Encrypt connects back to verify them.
website.selfSignedHint: A self-signed certificate triggers a browser warning. Use it for testing, or before the domain points here.

websiteErr.apply_failed: The web server rejected the configuration. The previous config was restored.

certErr.key_mismatch: The private key does not match the certificate.
certErr.issue_failed: Could not obtain the certificate. Check that the domain resolves here and port 80 is open.
certErr.in_use: The certificate is in use by website {websites}.
